**Mac**

**General Vendor**

**Ground Floor**

Walk up to the motorbike statue and turn west. Follow the corridor straight until you reach the first market stall on your left. Turn left and enter the stall.

Mac is on the ground floor, along the southern wall.

**Windy**

**Cryptid Hunter Vendor**

**Second Floor**

From Mac’s market stall, stand in front of the Punch Card Machine and face northwest. You’ll see a set of stairs next to the Lone Wanderer motorbike post. Run over and follow the stairs to the top. Face south and walk to the end of the corridor. Windy’s market stall is on your left.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_7faa74d839ed41a4ab4434cd01769004~mv2.jpg)

 **Inventory List**

Windy in Highway Town sells the Prototype ABX03 if you destroy, drop, or scrap yours by mistake. It will only appear in her inventory once you have collected all the Abraxodyne Intel Briefcases.

**Splint**

**Gun Vendor**

**Ground Floor**

From Clark’s and May’s market stall, continue walking west until you see the sign for The Last Resort Saloon. Stand out the front of the saloon and face southeast, you’ll be looking directly at Splint’s market stall.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_e2c7cd2869bf419eb0c99c8023a69969~mv2.jpg)

**Inventory List**

Splint in Highway Town sells the Meadow Breeze Sprayer if you destroy, drop, or scrap yours by mistake. It will only appear in her inventory once you have collected 76 Abraxodyne Intel Briefcases.

**Billie aka The Ghoul**

**Bounty Giver**

**Ground Floor**

From the motorbike statue at the spawn-in location, face west and follow the corridor straight until you reach a wall. Veer left around the wall and continue running west until you see a large Exit sign painted in blue. The Last Resort Saloon will be on your right.

Enter the saloon and face north. You’ll see The Ghoul directly ahead, against the back wall.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_37a8ee666027440d97d4c2ae0b5393e1~mv2.png)

Hey there, I'm Kat, also known as Duchess!

I'm an Aussie data miner who creates guides for farming, events, and food buffs in Fallout 76.

I firmly believe that knowledge should be accessible to everyone, so my guides will always be free. However, maintaining a website and using photo and video editing software can be costly.

If you find my guides useful, here are a few ways you can support me:

- Share My Guides: Help your fellow vault dwellers by sharing my guides.

- __Follow Me on Social Media:__ Keep up with my latest updates by following me on social media.

- __One-Time Donation:__ Buy me a coffee.

- __Monthly Contribution:__ Become a regular supporter by subscribing to my Ko-fi page.

Every bit of support helps cover the costs of creating these guides and maybe even gets me a cup of coffee or three ;)

Thanks for your support!
